correction: The capped command reads of the Problems page (T857 t6) believed killing the command process at the cap was enough. Reality: a descendant that inherited stdout or stderr kept the pipes open, so cmd.Wait blocked forever (WaitDelay was zero, and the context deadline does not close inherited pipes). execStream now starts the command in its own process group, kills the whole group at the cap and on context cancel (cmd.Cancel), closes the parent's stdout reader before Wait, calls Wait once, and sets WaitDelay to 2 seconds.
evidence: re-review 1 of the T857 t6 change; internal/problems.TestCappedReadKillsDescendantsThatHoldThePipes times out without the group kill and WaitDelay
